accepted_path_payload.content_address_semantics: The immutable candidate payload at the bound commit, blob OID, byte size and SHA-256 is the accepted B-D0 execution-gate and exact-evidence-path prerequisite. This envelope records delegated adjudication without modifying the candidate bytes.

adjudication.rationale: Current code, tests, contracts and project-local Skills prove a callable readiness and canonical Provider lifecycle plus an Agent-controlled exact Development evidence path for per-Shot, pairwise and whole-scene HUMAN review. The candidate binds exact attempts and media SHAs, stops on FAIL, NOT_EVALUATED, identity drift and unknown outcome, and forbids cross-lane inheritance. The absent typed Drama Product Runtime is explicitly outside B-D0 and remains future productization work after dual-domain empirical closure.
